name: Google Developer Groups RVCE
description: GDG RVCE is the RVCE chapter of the global Google Developer Groups community, bringing together students driven to explore, create, and innovate with technology. From hands-on workshops and hackathons to collaborative projects and technical initiatives, we turn curiosity into practical experience. We’re building a community where ideas are shared, skills are sharpened, and students are encouraged to build things that matter.

events.name: Beat Gemini: The Turing Challenge
events.detail: An event inspired by the Turing Test where participants compete to identify whether the content they're seeing was created by a human or by Gemini. Through multiple rounds, participants experience AI capabilities while learning about both its strengths and limitations.

events.name: Open Source Odyssey
events.detail: A puzzle trail where participants solve a series of challenges inspired by real open-source workflows. Each waypoint unlocks the next, offering a fun introduction to collaboration, problem-solving, and open source skills.

events.name: Google Arsenal
events.detail: A problem lands in your hands first the rest is up to you. Build it with Google's own tools but each one comes at a cost, and you won't have enough to have it all. Spend wisely, move fast, and build something worth pitching before the clock runs out.

events.name: Under the Floodlights
events.detail: A World Cup-inspired competition where participants alternate between describing and recreating hidden images using Gemini, testing their communication, creativity, and AI skills
